character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A young newcomer living in a 1990s Korean rural village, with short slightly messy black hair and a curious but cautious expression. Wearing a simple cream short-sleeved shirt, navy shorts, red canvas sneakers, and a small worn olive-green backpack. Slim childlike proportions with a slightly large head, short limbs, and a clear readable silhouette. Cozy rural mystery game character, muted natural colors, simple low-detail pixel art, restrained shading, subtle dark-brown selective outlines. No hat, no weapon, no item in hands, no modern accessories, no text.
